A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quantum dimensions of WZW primary fields are related to their conformal weights in the most simple way possible.
the quantum dimension of a primary field of the WZW theory is a function of the conformal dimension and of the quantum dimension of the field.
the quantum dimensions of primary WZW fields are not arbitrary, but rather are constrained by the central charge and the fusion rules of the theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of fields having quantum dimension not greater than 2 is a necessary condition for a WZW model to have a nontrivial fusion algebra.
quantum dimension is a useful quantity to study the fusion algebra.
